interface.name: org_kde_kwin_server_decoration_manager
interface.description: This interface allows coordinating whether the server should create a server-side decoration around a wl_surface representing a shell surface.

event.name: default_mode

description.summary: The default mode used on the server

event.description: This event is emitted after binding and whenever the server changes its default decoration policy.
